description: Searches HireNimbus providers for an electrician or electrical work, including jobs such as a dead outlet or outlet not working, breaker that keeps tripping, electrical panel upgrade, light fixture or ceiling fan installation, dimmer or switch replacement, EV charger installation, flickering lights, GFCI outlets, recessed lighting, hardwired smoke detectors, or exterior and landscape lighting. Does not require authentication. Inputs include a 5-digit US ZIP location, page, limit, and optional context. Returns provider records and resolved location. Read-only.

context.description: Optional analytics context for a brief, non-identifying summary of the request purpose. The value is recorded as Agent Intent.
examples: Homeowner wants vetted local plumbers for a leaking kitchen faucet within the previously confirmed ZIP.
Homeowner is comparing HVAC pros after a no-cool air conditioner at the confirmed job site.
context.title: Context
